svg.title: Selected work: four small islands
svg.desc: Four small islands joined by arches. SAGE: a round table with five chairs; a glowing token moves chair to chair, sometimes back between two, and a sound ripple runs above it. ResumeIQ: a scroll unrolls, its lines fly into a grid of 81 dots, then a four-part ring fills. Plant CNN: a magnifying glass slides over a leaf while layered squares stack and shrink and one of a row of bars lights; a tag reads 99.19%. SignBridge: a stone hand gains dots on its joints that join into a skeleton, a letter rises beside it, and one of 29 pips lights.
